text:
Brett Pesce missed a game earlier this month and has been back since, and he does exactly what New Jersey signed him to do. He has ten points in 21 games, nine of them assists, and the Devils take 59% of the five-on-five expected goals with him on (expected goals measure the quality of chances), four points better than without him. His point pace is well above his talent range, so expect fewer.

Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking shows a defenseman with a clear strength and a clear weakness. He stops 22% of the entries aimed at him, double the typical rate. But only 20% of his exits keep possession, so watch for clears off the glass when the forecheck comes. He spoke to the media before tonight's game against Columbus. With Johnathan Kovacevic out, he is even more of the Devils' shutdown spine. Our range has him around 30 points.
